import { insert as _insert, child as _child, txt as _txt, toDisplayString as _toDisplayString, setText as _setText, on as _on, renderEffect as _renderEffect, template as _template } from 'vue';
const t0 = _template("<form><button>x</button></form>")
const t1 = _template("<form></form>")
const t2 = _template("<ul><li>a</li></ul>")
const t3 = _template("<p></p>")
const t4 = _template("<p>two</p>")
const t5 = _template("<p>one</p>")
const t6 = _template("<a href=\"/y\">y</a>")
const t7 = _template("<a href=\"/x\"></a>")
const t8 = _template("<tr><td> </td></tr>")
const t9 = _template("<table></table>")

function render(_ctx, $props, $emit, $attrs, $slots) {
  const n1 = t1()
  const n3 = t3()
  const n5 = t5()
  const n7 = t7()
  const n9 = t9()
  const n0 = t0()
  const n2 = t2()
  const n4 = t4()
  const n6 = t6()
  const n8 = t8()
  const n10 = _child(n8)
  const x10 = _txt(n10)
  _on(n1, "submit", e => _ctx.a(e))
  _insert(n0, n1)
  _on(n0, "submit", e => _ctx.b(e))
  _insert(n2, n3)
  _insert(n4, n5)
  _insert(n6, n7)
  _insert(n8, n9)
  _renderEffect(() => _setText(x10, _toDisplayString(_ctx.cell)))
  return [n1, n3, n5, n7, n9]
}
const _sfc_main = { __vapor: true }
_sfc_main.render = render
export default _sfc_main
